# SyrupArk

## SyrupArk
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/SyrupArk.sol)

**Inherits:**
[ArkWithWithdrawalRequest](../ark-with-withdrawal-request.md)

**Title:**
SyrupArk

Ark contract for managing token supply and yield generation through Maple Finance Syrup pools

Implements strategy for depositing tokens with signature authorization and managing withdrawals


### State Variables
#### vault

```solidity
ISyrupPool public immutable vault
```


#### manager

```solidity
ISyrupManager public immutable manager
```


#### withdrawalManager

```solidity
ISyrupWithdrawalManager public immutable withdrawalManager
```


#### router

```solidity
ISyrupRouter public immutable router
```


#### summerReferralCode

```solidity
bytes32 public immutable summerReferralCode
```


### Functions
#### constructor

Constructor to set up the SyrupArk


```solidity
constructor(address _vault, address _router, ArkParams memory _params) ArkWithWithdrawalRequest(_params, 15);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_vault`|`address`|Address of the Syrup pool|
|`_router`|`address`|Address of the Syrup router|
|`_params`|`ArkParams`|ArkParams struct containing necessary parameters for Ark initialization|


#### totalAssets

Returns the total assets managed by this Ark


```solidity
function totalAssets() public view override(Ark, IArk) returns (uint256 assets);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assets`|`uint256`|Sum of withdrawable assets, shares in Ark, and shares in withdrawal queue|


#### claimWithdrawal

Syrup processes withdrawals automatically

This function is only callable by the keeper.


```solidity

```

#### isWithdrawalClaimRequired

Syrup processes withdrawals automatically

It's a keeper helper method to check if a claim is required.


```solidity

```
**Returns**

#### withdrawUsingSwap

Withdraws assets from the Ark using a swap

This function is only callable by the keeper


```solidity
function withdrawUsingSwap(uint256 amount, bytes calldata data) external onlyKeeper nonReentrant;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of assets to withdraw|
|`data`|`bytes`|The data to pass to the swap (router and swap calldata)|
